title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
description: An orphaned boy discovers he is a wizard and begins his first year at a magical school, where he makes loyal friends and faces a dark enemy.

title: The Alchemist
description: A young shepherd travels across the desert in search of treasure and learns to follow his dreams and listen to his heart.

title: Atomic Habits
description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through tiny daily changes that add up over time.

title: The Hobbit
description: A comfort-loving hobbit is swept into a dangerous quest with dwarves and a wizard to reclaim treasure guarded by a dragon.

title: The Da Vinci Code
description: A professor races through museums and churches to solve hidden codes and uncover a secret before a murderer catches him.

title: Wings of Fire
description: The inspiring life story of a boy from a small coastal town who rose through hard work to become a scientist building rockets for his country.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: A witty young woman and a proud wealthy gentleman misjudge each other, slowly falling in love as they overcome their first impressions.

title: The Hunger Games
description: In a cruel future nation, a teenage girl volunteers for a televised fight to the death and must survive in the wilderness against other children.

title: Sapiens
description: A sweeping history of humankind, explaining how our species went from hunting in small groups to building empires, money and modern science.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars uses science, humour and determination to grow food and survive until he can be rescued.
